title: Gerstner Ocean Waves
subtitle: Trochoidal Deep Water Wave Superposition
description: František Gerstner's exact nonlinear trochoidal ocean wave equation, exhibiting physically accurate sharpened wave crests and broad, flat troughs.
mathNotation: \mathbf{x} = \mathbf{x}_0 - \sum_{i=1}^{N} \frac{\mathbf{k}_i}{k_i} Q_i A_i \sin(\mathbf{k}_i \cdot \mathbf{x}_0 - \omega_i t), \quad y = y_0 + \sum_{i=1}^{N} A_i \cos(\mathbf{k}_i \cdot \mathbf{x}_0 - \omega_i t)
formulaCompact: x = x0 - (dx/k)*Q*sin(phase),  y = y0 - A*cos(phase),  phase = k*(dx*x0 + dy*y0) - ωt
